title: Why Helium's 4x Price Spike Could Happen Again
hook: Helium prices jumped 4x once, and demand is climbing again.
closing: A concentrated supply makes hospitals and manufacturers vulnerable when demand surges.
question: Should helium balloons cost more?

segments.say: Qatar holds 10.1 billion cubic meters of helium, concentrating global supply in a few countries.
Projected demand reaches 190 on the index, putting far more pressure on limited supplies.
Helium prices jumped 4 times during the supply crunch, showing how quickly shortages hit buyers.
